facts.fact: ISOC Pulse, from self-reported PeeringDB data, lists the Togo Internet Exchange Point (TGIX) in Lomé with 9 member ASNs and 18 Gbps cumulative port capacity, 7 of 9 peering at the route server, one ASN joined and none left in the last 12 months.
TGIX members registered outside Togo include PCH (two ASNs, United States), and GVA (Côte d'Ivoire), per ISOC Pulse/PeeringDB; 6 of 9 members are registered in Togo.
